mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id,r.project_id,r.release_id,a.agent_id,a.agent_version_id,a.name, a.evaluation_id,e.project_id AS evaluation_project_id,r.manifest_artifact_id AS artifact_id, ar.project_id AS artifact_project_id,a.revision,a.updated_at FROM release_record r JOIN agent_version a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.agent_version_id=r.agent_version_id JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND h.config_id=a.agent_id AND h.project_id <=> a.project_id AND h.kind='AGENT' AND h.current_version=a.agent_version_id JOIN evaluation_batch e ON e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND e.evaluation_id=a.evaluation_id JOIN artifact ar ON ar.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND ar.artifact_id=r.manifest_artifact_id WHERE a.status='PUBLISHED' AND (r.project_id IS NULL OR r.project_id=#{projectId}) AND r.release_id > #{after} AND (LOCATE(#{q},a.name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{q},CONVERT(r.release_id USING utf8mb4))>0) ORDER BY r.release_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
